title: I'm partially satisfied. Yes
text: I'm partially satisfied. Yes. I'm partially satisfied.  Yes, they make the eggs look neat.  Getting them out of the pan requires some practice.  Overall it takes too long to poach the eggs.  the old fashioned tried and true way works almost as good. I tried it several ways at different temperatures and I got the same result.  One time I put an egg in the water and the other in the cup and the one in the water was done much faster.  I would not buy again.  I'll keep playing with them but only if I have extra time for the eggs to be ready.  I learned a trick and that is to put your egg in a strainer so that all the water white runs out leaving the larger thick mass of white worth the yolk.  I put in hot water (not rolling hot water), and wait a couple of minutes.  Eggs keep their form. no vinegar required.  I was hoping to get a better result, oh well.
